explanation_full: Based on the SHAP analysis (Figure 3B), the feature importance scores are as follows: ORP_Low has a mean absolute SHAP value of 0.0352. Butyrate has a mean absolute SHAP value of 0.0334. ORP_Mid has a mean absolute SHAP value of 0.0296. COD-O has a mean absolute SHAP value of 0.0290. VFA has a mean absolute SHAP value of 0.0277. Acetate has a mean absolute SHAP value of 0.0265. The table evidence confirms these rankings, showing ORP_Low (0.0352) > Butyrate (0.0334) > ORP_Mid (0.0296) > COD-O (0.0290) > VFA (0.0277) > Acetate (0.0265).
